description: This file contains unit tests for the EncryptedDocument class within an Android project, focusing on encryption, decryption, metadata handling, reading/writing content, and error handling.

classes.name: EncryptedDocumentTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing EncryptedDocument functionalities such as reading/writing metadata, content, and error handling in an Android environment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creating a file object for testing.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up by deleting all files in the test directory after each test.

methods.name: testEmptyFile
methods.description: Tests behavior of EncryptedDocument when the file is empty, expecting exceptions on read attempts.

methods.name: testNormalMetadataAndContents
methods.description: Tests writing and reading normal-sized metadata and content.

methods.name: testGiantMetadataAndContents
methods.description: Tests handling of large content (over 1MB) including metadata and content.

methods.name: testMetadataAndContents
methods.description: Helper method for testing complete write/read cycle of metadata and content.

methods.name: testNormalMetadataOnly
methods.description: Tests behavior when only metadata is written and content is absent.

methods.name: testCopiedFile
methods.description: Verifies that reading with a different EncryptedDocument instance pointing to the same file fails due to digest mismatch.

methods.name: testBitTwiddle
methods.description: Tests integrity check by tampering with the file content and expecting a digest exception.

methods.name: testErrorAbortsWrite
methods.description: Checks that write operations are aborted upon errors, preserving original metadata.
